deployment_rule: local health and M2-A route verification first; then remote systemd/nginx mirror; no credential or local data copy

new_route_probes.meaning: the new routes were loaded; a syntactically valid unknown Bank caused no persistent test write

remote.service: systemd harnessagent bound to 127.0.0.1:8765; nginx /harness/ proxy

database_backup.kind: SQLite online backup before service stop

remote.source_sync: staged application copy excluded local SQLite, Keychain, test data and Evidence; source syntax was checked on target Python before restart

recovery_incident.impact: an initial promotion used rsync --delete without live-target exclusions and removed the remote virtual environment; the application service was briefly inactive
recovery_incident.data_impact: none known; the online SQLite backup had completed and no local data or credentials were copied
recovery_incident.recovery: recreated /opt/harnessagent/.venv from pinned requirements.txt, compiled M2-A files, restarted systemd, then repeated runtime, route and proxy checks
recovery_incident.prevention: AGENTS.md and OPERATIONS.md now require live-target exclusions for .venv and service-owned data during promotion

public_proxy.meaning: the existing HTTP Basic authentication boundary remains enforced; no Basic credential was read or recorded
